experiment: E2 zero-shot attributes vs linear probes
protocol:
Zero-shot attribute recognition vs the trained linear probes (campus case study).
      Labels: results/campus/validation/video_{1,2}_labels.tsv (the 100 held-out test tracks; "?" = not
      determinable, excluded). For each labelled test track the 3 best crops (highest score suffix of
      results/campus/<video>/crops/<track>_<frame>_<score>.jpg) are sent one by one with the closed-
      vocabulary uniform prompt of research/campus/campus_attributes.py (PROMPT, read from that file),
      upscaled exactly like campus_attributes.load_image. A track's label = majority vote over the crops
      ignoring "unsure"; a tie or no informative vote -> "unsure" (abstain). Scoring is campus_probe.evaluate's:
      accuracy over answered tracks, Wilson 95% CI, coverage = answered / labelled, per video and both.
      Probe numbers: results/campus/validation/probe_scores.json (per-track test); per-track probe outputs
      from results/campus/<video>/attributes.json (checked to reproduce probe_scores.json) for an exact
      McNemar test on the tracks both methods answered.

settings.upscale: campus_attributes.load_image: height >= 448 px, longest side <= 896 px, bicubic
settings.prompt:
This is a crop of one person from a video of an Indian university campus.

The student uniform is:
- men: a plain white or off-white shirt with khaki / beige trousers.
- women: a sleeveless beige / khaki overcoat (vest) worn over a white or cream kurta, with white or khaki bottoms.
Anything else (jeans, T-shirts, coloured or printed shirts or kurtas, sarees, other outfits) is not the uniform.

Answer with only this JSON, choosing each value from the listed options:
{"gender": "male|female|unsure",
 "dress": "uniform|non_uniform|unsure"}
Use "unsure" only if the crop does not show enough.
settings.vote: majority over crops ignoring unsure; tie or no informative vote -> unsure (abstain)
settings.probe: campus_probe.py linear probes (DINOv2 features, mean prob over up to 6 crops, abstain when |p-0.5| < 0.15)

server_version: built with GNU 11.4.0 for Linux x86_64
